summary: The DGA card: a surface with an optional featured icon, heading and description, the projected body and an actions slot. Use it to group one topic on a dashboard, landing or detail page.

inputs.name: heading
inputs.description: The card heading (translated). Named heading, not title, so no native tooltip appears.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: A short paragraph under the heading (translated).

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Decorative featured icon above the heading.

inputs.name: effect
inputs.description: Border, elevation or a flat surface.

inputs.name: centered
inputs.description: Centres the icon, heading and description.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: aria-level of the heading in the page outline; other values are clamped, NaN uses 3.

slots.description: Actions at the end of the card, usually dga-button elements.

a11y: Renders a section named by its heading (aria-labelledby), and the heading is exposed with role=heading and aria-level, so screen-reader users can jump to the card. The icon is decorative. Layout uses logical CSS and mirrors in RTL.
